question: Which among the following festivals is also celebrated to remember King Mahabali in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Onam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam is a harvest festival celebrated in the Indian state of Kerala to remember King Mahabali, who is believed to have ruled Kerala in ancient times.**
 
• It is celebrated in the Malayalam month of Chingam, which usually falls in August or September.
 
• The festival is marked by various rituals and cultural activities, including the famous snake boat race, called Vallamkali.
 
• Onam is an annual **Malayali harvest festival celebrated in the state of Kerala.**
 
• It is the official festival of the state and includes a spectrum of cultural events.
 
• Onam is celebrated to honor the homecoming of a mythical demon king Mahabali.
 
 
• He is the **grandson of Prahlada and a descendant of sage Kashyapa.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishu is another important festival celebrated in Kerala, which marks the beginning of the Malayalam New Year.** It is usually celebrated in April.
 
• **Ugadi is a New Year festival celebrated in the southern states of India, including Andhra Pradesh,** Telangana, and Karnataka. It usually falls in March or April.
 
• **Puthandu or Tamil New Year** is celebrated in the state of Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka in mid-April.
